en.title: Leave Types
en.summary: The kinds of leave staff can take — annual, sick, maternity.

sections.heading: The two settings
sections.body:
• Maximum Days Allowed — the most that can be taken in one request.
• Drawn From Accrued Balance — tick it for annual leave, which spends the days staff have earned. Leave that is not ticked, like sick leave, is recorded without touching the balance.

sections.heading: Retiring an entry
sections.body: Set it Inactive. It leaves the pickers, and every record that already uses it keeps showing it. Delete is for mistakes only, and only a super admin can do it.

am.title: የፈቃድ ዓይነቶች
am.summary: ሠራተኞች ሊወስዷቸው የሚችሉ የፈቃድ ዓይነቶች — ዓመታዊ፣ ሕመም፣ ወሊድ።

sections.heading: ሁለቱ ቅንብሮች
sections.body:
• Maximum Days Allowed — በአንድ ጥያቄ ሊወሰድ የሚችለው ከፍተኛ ቀን።
• Drawn From Accrued Balance — ሠራተኞች ያጠራቀሙትን ቀን ለሚጠቀመው ዓመታዊ ፈቃድ ምልክት ያድርጉ። ምልክት ያልተደረገበት ፈቃድ፣ እንደ ሕመም ፈቃድ፣ ቀሪውን ሳይነካ ይመዘገባል።

sections.heading: መዝገብን ከአገልግሎት ማስወጣት
sections.body: "Inactive" ያድርጉት። ከምርጫ ዝርዝሮቹ ይወጣል፤ ቀድሞ የተጠቀሙበት መዝገቦች ሁሉ ግን ማሳየታቸውን ይቀጥላሉ። መሰረዝ ለስህተት ብቻ ነው፤ ሊሰርዝ የሚችለውም ሱፐር አድሚን ብቻ ነው።
